verdict.rationale: Zulip's official API documents sending messages, and its bot framework lets custom bots react to messages, which implies reading them. A machine-readable OpenAPI spec backs the API. Nothing in the pack covers scoped or permission-limited tokens, an explicit message-read endpoint, or agent-specific credentials. missing for 10: scoped/least-privilege token documentation, explicit get-messages/read endpoint evidence, bot credential permission model, hands-on corroboration of an agent reading and posting.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent read and post channel messages through the official API using scoped tokens

citations.quote: Zulip’s API has a powerful framework for interactive bots that react to messages in Zulip. You can write and run a custom bot, or run an existing Zulip bot.
The zulip/zulip repository ships a complete OpenAPI 3.0.1 description of the API, info title "Zulip REST API", at zerver/openapi/zulip.yaml.
